execution: D1 native thinking, batch 1, prompt prefill chunks of 256, then single generated tokens
event_boundary: first complete paragraph boundary observed in the native token stream; include the last partial paragraph on observed think close for coverage only
repeated_paragraph_rule: third occurrence of exactly the same nonempty whitespace-normalized casefolded paragraph
rng_checkpoints: all event boundaries observed while thinking remains open
denominators: 24 distinct problems, 48 seeded trajectories, event subsets reported separately
worker_assignment: (zero-based question index + zero-based seed index) modulo 2
